My academic research centered on finding structure in large, noisy systems —
community detection in complex networks, extreme value statistics, and
synchronization in nonlinear dynamical systems. The methods below —
particularly extreme value theory and uncertainty quantification — carry
directly over into the tail-risk and model-validation problems in
quantitative finance.
